editorial:
Imagine growing up with nothing, scraping by by picking up scrap paper and bottles just to survive. That is where you meet Jong-dae and Yong-ki, two best friends who dream of a better life. The story takes you back to the 1970s in Seoul, where the government decides to turn a swampy area called Gangnam into a massive city. It starts as a story about friendship, but it quickly turns into a gritty world of gangs, bribes, and dirty politics. You get to see how these two friends end up on opposite sides as they climb the ladder of the criminal underworld, fighting for power and money in a city that is changing overnight.

You will really enjoy the raw acting and the way the movie shows the dark side of success. The action is punchy, though the pacing slows down a bit in the middle to focus on the political drama. If you like stories about loyalty and betrayal, you should definitely check this one out. It looks great in high definition, so if you can, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best experience. If you are a collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a smart move because the colors and city backgrounds look stunning.
endingExplained: The story ends in a sad way. Jong-dae and Yong-ki, once best friends, end up as enemies because of greed and power. In the final showdown, the friendship is completely broken. Jong-dae realizes that the people in power just used him as a tool. The movie wraps up by showing that while Gangnam became a wealthy place, it was built on blood and betrayal, leaving the main characters broken and alone.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves crime sagas and stories about friendship turned sour.
